projects.name: nucleo-h755zi-q-baremetal-bringup
projects.description: Bare-Metal ARM Cortex-M Engineering (STM32) | Independent Systems Initiative

Configured hardware peripherals (including GPIO) strictly through memory-mapped I/O utilizing C pointers, volatile memory access, and precise read-modify-write bit manipulation.

projects.name: OneByte Protocol
projects.description: Custom Binary Application-Layer Protocol | Network Engineering Initiative
highlights: Designed and hand-coded a compact application-layer protocol utilizing explicit bit-level serialization to pack multiple application states into a single-byte payload.

Programmed the compression and decoding pipelines using logical bitwise masking and shifting operations, achieving a 98% reduction in transmission bandwidth relative to standard JSON serialization.
